text:
Nora (CS): Heads-up: Solstice Health renewal. They requested a 12mo term with a 10% platform credit, want to pay via PO but the signer will be their procurement arm (Solstice Procurement Ltd) while remit and tax belong to Solstice Health Inc (US). Also asking for e-sign via partner portal. @Ethan can you confirm what's negotiable?
Ethan (AE): They want the 10% applied to monthly invoices, not upfront. PO will be PO-9901. Signed by procurement ltd in UK. Remit-to is US entity with EIN 98-7654321.
Priya (Legal): If signer != billed entity we need evidence of authority. Acceptable docs: board resolution, POA, or signed delegation letter on corporate letterhead. E-sign via partner portal is fine if DocuSign audit trail included. Ask them to include a clear scope of signing authority.
Ravi (Finance): We can accept PO-9901 for monthly invoices but must reconcile remit tax details before mapping vendor code. We'll need a completed W-9 for Solstice Health Inc. Also confirm if the PO contains payment terms that conflict with our MSA.
Maya (Onboarding): Onboarding timeline depends on billing mapping. We can kick off training sessions with limited seats but full SSO provisioning requires remit and invoice mapping to be complete.
billing-bot: Created invoice_ticket #INV-9102 and vendor_mapping request VM-557. Assigned to @Ravi.
Nora (CS): Proposed actions: 1) Ethan to ask customer for PO-9901 upload + W-9 for Solstice Health Inc + delegation doc linking procurement ltd to remit entity, 2) Priya to review delegation doc, 3) Ravi to validate W-9 and map vendor once docs verified, 4) Maya to schedule onboarding provisional sessions pending vendor mapping.
Ethan (AE): Message I'll send: "Please attach PO-9901, remit W-9 for Solstice Health Inc, and a delegation doc (board resolution, POA, or delegation letter) showing Solstice Procurement Ltd is authorized to sign commercial agreements and remit invoices to Solstice Health Inc. Please confirm DocuSign audit trail will be preserved."
Priya (Legal): Quick note: if the delegation doc only references procurement for purchasing, it may not be enough. Ask them to explicitly grant commercial contract signing authority. If red flags, I'll request a notarized POA.
Ravi (Finance): If they want the 10% as a recurring monthly credit, we'll apply it after vendor mapping; confirm the credit calculation in writing so AR can automate entries. Wires preferred for initial setup fees; otherwise card for single payment.
Maya (Onboarding): If we get PO + W-9 + delegation by EOD Wed, I can provision test SSO account and schedule kickoff for next Tue. Otherwise we do sandbox-only.
Nora (CS): Customer replied: "Uploading PO-9901 and W-9 now, delegation letter attached. We'll sign via our partner portal with DocuSign." I'll post attachments when in. Tracking: INV-9102 open, VM-557 pending, delegation under review.
